title: Agniveer  SSR, MR & SSR (Medical)
qualification: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology (PCB) with 50% marks in aggregate and minimum 40% in each subject from Boards recognised by Ministry of Education, Government of India
salary: During the initial training period, a stipend of Rs. 14,600/- per month will be admissible to candidates. || On successful completion of initial training, candidates will be placed in Level 3 of the Defence Pay Matrix (Rs. 21,700 – Rs. 69,100) with Military Service Pay (MSP) of Rs. 5,200/- per month plus Dearness Allowance as applicable. || Promotion prospects exist up to the rank of Master Chief Petty Officer-I, corresponding to Level 8 of the Defence Pay Matrix (Rs. 47,600 – Rs. 1,51,100) plus MSP Rs. 5,200/- per month plus DA as applicable. || During training and service, sailors are provided books, reading material, uniforms, food and accommodation as per entitlement. || Sailors are entitled to medical treatment, Leave Travel Concession for self and dependents, Group Housing benefits, Annual and Casual leave, Children Education and House Rent Allowances, and post-retirement benefits including pension, gratuity and leave encashment as per service conditions and Government orders.
age_limit: Candidates should be born between 01 May 2005 and 31 October 2009 (both dates inclusive). || Candidates born within these dates are eligible to apply for Stage I – INET 2026 and will be considered for Stage II of SSR (MED) 02/2027 batch as per stated age criteria. || Only unmarried male candidates meeting the age range are eligible for enrolment as sailors in SSR (Med) 02/2027 batch.
application_fee: An examination fee of Rs. 550/- (Rupees Five hundred fifty only) plus 18% GST is to be paid by candidates during Stage I – INET application. || The fee must be paid in online mode using net banking, Visa/Master/RuPay Credit/Debit Card or UPI. || Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances, nor can it be held in reserve for any other examination or selection. || Candidates found to have registered multiple times will be rejected and debarred from the examination, and reimbursement of exam fee will not be carried out in such cases. || Fee will be charged only during Stage I – INET application, and there will be no separate fee for Stage II process.
selection_process: The selection process consists of Stage I – INET (Indian Navy Entrance Test) followed by Stage II (Physical Fitness Test, Written Examination and Recruitment Medical) and Pre-Enrolment Medicals. || Stage I – INET is a computer-based examination with 100 objective-type (multiple-choice) questions, each carrying 1 mark. || The Stage I question paper is bilingual (Hindi & English) and comprises four sections: English, Science, Biology and General Awareness. || The standard of Stage I question paper is that of 10+2, and syllabus and sample papers are available on the official website. || The duration of Stage I examination is one hour, and candidates are required to pass in all sections as well as in aggregate; pass marks in each section and aggregate are determined by the Indian Navy. || Negative marking is applicable in Stage I – one fourth (0.25) marks will be deducted for each wrong answer. || Centre allocation for INET (online examination) is at the discretion of the Indian Navy. || In case of extraneous circumstances causing non-conduct of INET or as per service requirement, Indian Navy reserves the right to shortlist candidates based on marks obtained in qualifying examinations (10th/12th board exams). || Candidates eligible for Stage II as per age criteria will be shortlisted for SSR (Medical) 02/2027 batch based on marks obtained in Stage I – INET 2026. || Shortlisting for Stage II will be carried out state wise, and cut-off marks for next stage will vary from state to state as vacancies are allotted state-wise. || If candidates with the same percentage exceed required numbers, shortlisting will be done based on Date of Birth, with earlier DOB (fewer chances) given priority. || Sponsor candidates and NCC ‘C’ certificate holders who upload original sponsor and NCC certificates during Stage I application and whose certificates are verified will be exempted from Stage I – INET and will be directly issued call-up for Stage II based on eligibility. || Stage II begins with Physical Fitness Test (PFT), which is mandatory; candidates undergoing PFT do so at their own risk. || PFT standards for male candidates are: 1.6 km run in 6 min 30 sec, 20 Squats (Uthak Baithak), 15 Push-ups and 15 Bent Knee Sit-ups. || The Stage II written exam is conducted only for candidates who qualify the PFT and consists of 100 objective-type questions of 1 mark each. || The Stage II written exam question paper is bilingual (Hindi & English) and comprises four sections: English, Science, Biology and General Awareness, with 10+2 level standard and one-hour duration. || Candidates must pass in all sections and in aggregate in the Stage II written exam; pass marks are set by the Indian Navy. || Recruitment Medical Examination is carried out for candidates who qualify PFT; candidates who qualify Recruitment Medical are considered for the merit list. || Candidates found medically unfit in Recruitment Medical may appeal for review at a designated military hospital within 5 days; medical certificates from other hospitals are not accepted and no further review/appeal is permissible. || Provisional Select List is prepared based on performance in Stage II written exam, subject to qualification in PFT and Recruitment Medical; merit list for SSR (Medical) is state-wise and cut-off for call-up to INS Chilka varies by state. || Pre-Enrolment Medical formalities are conducted at INS Chilka and induction is subject to qualifying these formalities; candidates not qualifying pre-enrolment medicals will be rejected.
